And we will give a special big discount this time too."
"Thank you, lady.

I'm also happy to have the opportunity to be on this amazing TV show." of course, Xiao Tian needed to praise the TV shows because these were unspoken rules if you wanted to promote something on TV shows.
"Good question, lady.

The reason why I'm the one who promotes our clothing designs is that I'm the one who designs the clothes, so in my view, I know the most about our clothing designs." actually, Xiao Tian also wanted to make Shi Fei or Lin Xing Xue as the person who promoted his clothing designs.
But he suddenly changed his mind because, in his view, he was the best person to do that.
Even though Xiao Tian had guessed that something like this would happen, but seeing it with his own eyes felt different.
After Xiao Tian finished explaining, the male models walked toward the small stage.
The models were wearing a parka jacket, jeans, and a T-shirt.
And like before, Xiao Tian began explaining the excess of clothing designs in detail.
After several minutes, Xiao Tian finished explaining all of his clothing designs.
"Sure." Xiao Tian was pleased when Rui Qing ended the small talk because he wanted to promote his clothing designs immediately.
"Yes.
We will only give high discounts during broadcasting, so you will not get a discount as high as this time if you buy our clothing designs after this broadcasting ends.
I am sure that you all will not regret it if you buy our clothing designs now." Xiao Tian added.
"We will give a different discount for each clothes." of course, Xiao Tian would give different discounts because each clothing design has a different profit.
"For a woman's clothing like jeans skirt and gore skirt, we will give a 50% discount.
For off-the-shoulder top and rib-knit turtleneck, we will give a 40% discount.
For a cocktail dress and bias-cut dress, we will give a 30% discount.
As for male clothing designs, we will give a 50% discount."
Xiao Tian was pleased when he saw the expression on Rui Qing's face.
He didn't expect that she was good at pretending to be surprised.
"Do not worry, lady Rui.
The clothing designs that we want to promote are good with high-quality materials.
You won't regret it if you buy our clothing designs later."
"Wow!
You give a high discount on these beautiful clothing designs." Rui Qing then looked toward the camera and began promoting Xiao Tian's clothing designs." What are you waiting for?
This is a rare chance to get beautiful clothing designs at low prices."

"It seems like Mr.

"All right, Mr.
Xiao.
I'm sure the viewers at home want to see the clothing designs immediately so, how about you show us your clothing designs now?"
Without waiting for another second, Xiao Tian and Rui Qing walked toward the models.
When Xiao Tian saw that thirty of his clothing designs had been sold, he could not help but smile.
Then Xiao Tian and Rui Qing talked about the clothing designs again, and of course, they also promoted it.
In order to make the atmosphere lively, Rui Qing decided to have a small talk first.
"Mr.
Xiao, we are very pleased to welcome a talented young man like you on our TV show."
Many people only paid attention to high discounts, so when they knew some clothes have high discounts, they would immediately be interested.
What they didn't realize was that the prices had been raised before the discount was given
At this time, Rui Qing had no idea that the prices had been raised before, because Xiao Tian didn't tell them about it.
Then they sat on the black chairs with one long white table in front of them, and each of them had mineral water on the table.
Then Xiao Tian and Rui Qing walked out of the room.
Outside the hall, Shi Fei, and Lin Xing Xue had been waiting for him with a smile on their faces.

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - How About I Kiss Both Of You As A Reward?
paragraphs: At that time, Xiao Tian wanted to embrace Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei immediately, but he knew he couldn't do that because it would create a rumor about them.
It was not that Xiao Tian didn't want the public to know about their relationship, but because Xiao Tian thought that it was not the right time for the public to find out about their relationship.
When Xiao Tian noticed the expression on Lin Xing Xue's face, he knew that she was jealous. However, Xiao Tian also realized that it would be a mistake if he continued talking to Rui Qing.
Then Xiao Tian put his hands around their waist and said, "You two have worked hard today. How about I kiss both of you as a reward?"
"Congratulation, Mr. Xiao." the models said in unison.
"Yes." Lin Xing Xue added as she nodded her head.
Because Xiao Tian wanted a kiss, he covered Lin Xing Xue's eyes with his left hand and looked at Shi Fei.

Lin Xing Xue had guessed that Xiao Tian would kiss her later. That was why when Xiao Tian cupped her face, Lin Xing Xue did nothing. She even slowly shut her eyes as if she was giving him a sign that she was ready to welcome the kiss.
When Xiao Tian saw the expression on their faces, he smiled and said, "It's fine. But remember it next time. Come here and sit next to me."
"Thank you, lady Lin and lady Shi." because Xiao Tian was unable to embrace them, he could only smile.
"No. It's because your clothing designs are indeed beautiful." Rui Qing was sure that without her help, Xiao Tian would still succeed because his clothing designs were indeed beautiful.
'Good! Today is another big success for me.'
After eating, Xiao Tian, Lin Xing Xue, and Shi Fei traveled to the company.
"Oh! My girlfriend understands me very well." Xiao Tian spoke and paused for a second before he continued, "So, will you kiss me?"
This made Xiao Tian's lips twitch. "Little Xue, Fei, you two should knock first before entering my office."
After kissing Shi Fei, Xiao Tian suddenly wanted to kiss Lin Xing Xue too. For this reason, he cupped her face and looked into her eyes.
Xiao Tian, who was sitting on the couch in his office, smiled happily.
Upon hearing his words, Lin Xing Xue looked at him and pinched his nose, "How can you say that as a reward for us? You mean, a reward for you, right?"
But Lin Xing Xue didn't hate it. She just found it funny that he could think of many ways only to make her kiss him.
Hoh! So, you are still trying to get close to little brother, huh? Shi Fei thought to herself.
Not long after that, Shi Fei and Lin Xing Xe entered his office. Maybe because they were happy, they entered his office without knocking.
"So, why did you come to my office?" Xiao Tian inquired.
What if they suddenly entered his office when Xiao Tian was doing something with a lady or when he wanted time to be alone.

"All right." even though Rui Qing still wanted to talk to Xiao Tian, but she knew that she could not do that. It was their first meeting, so if she annoyed him, he wouldn't want to meet her again in the future.
Because Lin Xing Xue was next to him, they only kissed for about two seconds before finally, Xiao Tian broke the kiss. Then Xiao Tian began stroking Lin Xing Xue's hair again.
After that, Xiao Tian, Lin Xing Xue, Shi Fei, and the models went to Bamboo Restaurant to eat. As they were eating, they were talking and laughing together as if they were friends.
"Thank you. You all did a good job earlier." Xiao Tian was pleased with their work because earlier, the models did an excellent job.

"Pretend to faint? CPR? Just tell me if you want a kiss from me. You don't need to use an excuse like that." Lin Xing Xue had no idea that Xiao Tian had many ways to make her kiss him. He even said that he would pretend to faint so that she would kiss him.

It was not that Xiao Tian was afraid of Lin Xing Xue but because he had to make her happy first before finally telling her that he has three other girlfriends besides her. "Lady Rui, we will take our leave first because we still have something to do."

And like before, Lin Xing Xue only looked at Rui Qing and Xiao Tian. Actually, she wanted to drag Xiao Tian out of the studio, but she understood if she did that, other people would know that she had a special relationship with her boss.
Without waiting for another second, Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei sat next to Xiao Tian; Shi Fei was sitting on his right side, while Lin Xing Xue was sitting on the other side.
"We are glad that you are satisfied with our work, Sir." the models spoke in unison.
As if they could communicate through their eyes, Shi Fei understood that Xiao Tian wanted a kiss from her. Without waiting for another second, Shi Fei tilted her head and kissed his lips.

"Congratulation, Sir." Shi Fei and Lin Xing Xue said in unison. Because they were not alone, they had to keep working professionally. That was why Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei behaved like his subordinates, who were happy for their boss's success.
The models were thrilled when they knew that Xiao Tian's clothing designs sold very well during broadcast because it meant they did an excellent job earlier.

As usual, Xiao Tian did nothing and let Lin Xing Xue pinch his nose. "Love, you should not pinch your lover's nose. What if he can't breathe and faint? Will you give him CPR? If so, then I will pretend to faint."

When Xiao Tian was talking with Shi Fei, Lin Xing Xue, and the models, Rui Qing walked toward them again. When she was in front of Xiao Tian, she smiled and said, "Mr. Xiao, once again, congratulation."
When Shi Fei noticed the expression on Lin Xing Xue's face, she couldn't help but giggle.

"Thank you. This is because lady Rui also helped me earlier, so thank you, lady Rui." Xiao Tian didn't expect that Rui Qing still wanted to get close to him. She didn't even care that other people were looking at her.
Even though they were his girlfriends, but Xiao Tian had to remind them that they had to knock on the door before entering his office.
"I don't want to. Hehe." Lin Xing Xue giggled and stopped pinching his nose.
Because Lin Xing Xue didn't want to kiss him, Xiao Tian moved up his left hand from her waist to head before finally, stroking her hair.
When Lin Xing Xue felt Xiao Tian's hand stroking her hair gently, she placed her head on his shoulders and enjoyed it.
"We are still feeling happy upon remembering that today is a big success for us." Shi Fei gave him an honest answer.
"Sorry." Shi Fei and Lin Xing Xue said in unison.
Without waiting for another second, Xiao Tian brought his face closer toward hers before finally, their lips met.

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - Stars Hill
paragraphs: After that, they talked for about fifteen minutes before finally, they began to work.
When Xiao Tian was working, he suddenly remembered something. For this reason, he called Shi Fei to meet him.
Like when Xiao Tian entered her apartment, Shi Fei immediately hugged his right arm again.
Previously, Xiao Tian bought roasted corn with a different flavor; sweet and spicy and sweet and cheese.
When Xiao Tian saw an empty wooden bench, he pointed his index finger toward it and said, "Fei, wait on that wooden bench. I want to buy roasted corn first."
Because Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei had returned home, Xiao Tian headed to the parking lot before going home.
"Little brother?" Shi Fei was surprised when she saw Xiao Tian in front of her apartment. But of course, she was pleased by his unexpected visit. "Come in."
"Yes. You're right." Xiao Tian admitted that Shi Fei was the sexiest among all his women. "Sexy and beautiful."
Shi Fei was pleasantly surprised when Xiao Tian suddenly invited her out. "All right."
"I will bring it now." then Shi Fei walked out of his office room. And after a brief moment, Shi Fei returned to Xiao Tian's office again. "Here, little brother."
Because Xiao Tian still has a lot of work, he began working again. Time went by quickly, and without realizing it, it was already 06:20 pm.
"Un." Shi Fei nodded her head before walking toward the wooden bench.
Xiao Tian stopped reading a document and looked at her. "Are the clothes ready?"
Xiao Tian's face broke into a soft smile when Shi Fei was walking out of his office. He didn't expect that she would kiss him before returning to her office.
"Here, take this." Xiao Tian gave one of the roasted corns to her before sitting on the wooden bench.
"Stars Hill?" Shi Fei touched her chin before nodding her head. "Good idea. Let's go."
Shi Fei's face broke into a smile when Xiao Tian suddenly praised her. "Hehe. Didn't you say that I'm the sexiest lady?"
'Have they already returned home?'
From Stars Hill, the visitors could see the beautiful night of Shanghai. The twinkling lights below them, the shining stars above them, and tall buildings were the main attraction on the Stars Hill.
The corner of Xiao Tian's lips twitched when he found out the Shi Fei's and Lin Xing Xue's offices were empty.
However, when Xiao Tian was on his way to his home, he suddenly wanted to meet Shi Fei. For this reason, Xiao Tian traveled to Shi Fei's apartment.
Stars Hill was located in the Wanhui district. It was called Stars Hill because its location was several thousand meters above sea level.
Because his workbench was full of documents, Xiao Tian placed the clothes on the couch so that he wouldn't forget to bring it home later.
After a brief moment, Xiao Tian walked toward Shi Fei with two roasted corns in his hands.

Xiao Tian could not help but smile when he saw the happy expression on her face. Maybe, because he rarely went on a date with her, Shi Fei was thrilled when Xiao Tian wanted to bring her to Stars Hill.
Knock...Knock...Knock...
"Yes." because the clothes were ready, Xiao Tian wanted to see it because he wanted to know the results.
Without waiting for another second, Shi Fei immediately took a bite out of his roasted corn. "It's delicious."
This made Xiao Tian pleased because, with this, he knew that Shi Fe was looking forward to going out with him.
"Where are we going?" Shi Fei asked when she was in front of him.
At this time, Xiao Tian thought that he had to wait a long time until she finished preparing herself, but he was wrong because Shi Fei only needed ten minutes to dress up.
The sound of someone opening the door could be heard in his ears.
"Do you miss me, little brother?" the smile on Shi Fei's face grew bigger after sitting on Xiao Tian's lap.

This made Xiao Tian a little surprised. Usually, when it was time to go home, Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei would come to his office, but it was already past work time, and they still hadn't come to his office.
After Xiao Tian was in the living room, he immediately sat on the couch. But to his surprise, Shi Fei suddenly sat on his lap and put her left arm around his neck.
For this reason, Xiao Tian rose from his seat and put the clothes in his bag. With a smile on his face, Xiao Tian walked out of his office.
"What is it, little brother?" Shi Fei asked when she was in front of him.
When Xiao Tian was checking the clothes, he nodded his head in satisfaction. "Good!"
"Yes." Xiao Tian nodded his head. "Change your clothes. Let's go out now."
When Xiao Tian was sitting on the couch, Shi Fei suddenly kissed his cheeks before walking out of his office. "I will go back to work, little brother."
"Sweet and spicy." because Xiao Tian thought that Shi Fei wanted to get a taste of his roasted corn, he placed it in front of her mouth. "Here, taste it."
Click...
After Xiao Tian reached her apartment, he immediately knocked on the door.
To his surprise, Shi Fei suddenly sat between his legs and said, "It's beautiful."
After several minutes of driving, they finally arrived at Stars Hill.
When Xiao Tian stepped into her apartment, Shi Fei immediately hugged his right arm and smiled happily.
Shi Fei then looked at Xiao Tian and asked, "Little brother, what is the flavor of your roasted corn?"
"Yes." Shi Fei nodded her head. "Do you want to see it now?"
Xiao Tian immediately embraced her with his left arm before eating the roasted corn. "Un. It's beautiful. Like my lover, who is in my embrace right now."
Xiao Tian rose from the couch and replied, "How about we go to Stars Hill?"
Then Xiao Tian and Shi Fei continued eating roasted corn while enjoying the beautiful night of Shanghai.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - What Made You Fall For Me?
paragraphs: Even though Shi Fei and Xiao Tian had finished eating roasted corn, they remained in the same position as if they didn't want to separate from each other. Currently, Xiao Tian was placing his arms around Shi Fei's waist while she was putting her head on his shoulders.

"Little brother, did you go straight to my apartment after leaving the company?" Shi Fei was curious when she saw Xiao Tian was still wearing work clothes. That was why she immediately asked about it.
"Hehe." Shi Fei giggled after hearing his words. "Are you unable to live without me anymore?"
Then Xiao Tian and Shi Fei talked about many things. They were at Stars Hill until 09:00 pm before finally, they decided to return home.
After they arrived at Shi Fei's apartment, Xiao Tian didn't immediately return home; instead, he walked to her apartment.
"Tell me, or I won't stop tickling your waist." Xiao Tian said while still tickling her.
"Wrong again?" Xiao Tian tried to think of another answer. "Because of my kindness?"
"Hmmm." Shi Fei touched her chin for three seconds before finally, answering. "Hehe. I think you can't live without me anymore."
"Fei, what made you fall for me?" until now, Xiao Tian had no idea what made Shi Fei fall in love with him because he had never done anything special to her.
Shi Fei brought her face closer to his left ear and whispered, "Secret."
Instead of answering, Shi Fei looked at him and asked, "What do you think?"
"Because of my good looks?" Xiao Tian answered shamelessly.
At this moment, Shi Fei was curious about what he wanted to do. Her eyes widened in surprise when Xiao Tian suddenly kissed her lips.
And like before, Xiao Tian kissed her lips again. But this time, he kissed her lips longer than before.

Like before, after Lan Ruoxi clapped two times, a mature lady entered the room and walked toward them.
"Don't worry.
In one or two hours, I will give you information on who helped Feng Ao get out of prison." Lan Ruoxi had many connections, so she believed that she would find out about it quickly.
"What?" Xiao Tian said in surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - Blue Ice Lotus Gang
paragraphs: Somewhere in the car.
"Thank you for saving me." Feng Ao was truly grateful when the green-haired man next to him suddenly came and helped him escape. Otherwise, he didn't know what Xiao Tian would do to him.
"Tell me." Xiao Tian said.

Feng Ao didn't expect that Xiao Tian was good at fighting. Earlier, he thought that he could win against Xiao Tian, but he was wrong. He was utterly wrong because Xiao Tian was better than him at a martial art.
When Lan Ruoxi saw the expression on his face, she immediately asked, "What's wrong? Why did you make an expression like this?"

"Blue Ice Lotus gang is a female gang. It's one of the strongest gangs in Nanli district now. In the past, it was once the most feared gang in Nanli district when the founder was still the leader. All the people who know about Blue Ice Lotus refers to the founder of the gang as the devil queen, but to the members of the gang, she is like an angel." Shi Fei added. "Their mottos are never to hurt innocent people and protect women. I never thought that they would no longer obey their mottos."
Even though Xiao Tian was furious and wanted to destroy Blue Ice Lotus gang immediately, but he knew what the most important thing to do at that moment was.

"Do you know the location of Blue Ice Lotus gang?" Xiao Tian asked with a flame of fury in his eyes. He didn't care whether it was a woman or a man. As long as they dared to make trouble to him, he would destroy them. Those were the words that his past life father always told him.
"I don't know."
Not long after that, Shi Fei arrived at the company. "What happened?"
"What do you mean by that?" Xiao Tian inquired, "There are gangs, so it's normal. As long as someone pays them, they will do anything, right?"
Upon hearing Shi Fei's words, Xiao Tian looked at her and asked, "Fei, do you know who they are?"

Because Lan Ruoxi didn't want Xiao Tian to act boldly, she immediately said, "Young master Xiao, Blue Ice Lotus gang is a dangerous gang, so you can't act without a plan. After we bring your employees to the hospital, we can talk about this."
'Who did all this?'
Lin Xing Xue held Xiao Tian's hands and said, "Tian, do you want to go to Blue Ice Lotus headquarters? Don't do that. It's dangerous. Let's the police handle all this."
With a worried face, Xiao Tian began to look for Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei. When he found Lin Xing Xue, he dashed toward her and asked, "Little Xue, are you alright?"
Lan Ruoxi rose from his lap and said, "I will come with you."
Lin Xing Xue started explaining what had happened at the company. And like Xiao Tian, Shi Fei was furious, but she didn't show it on her face.
And not only that, but he was also alone, so it would be impossible for him to destroy Blue Ice Lotus gang alone. For this reason, he intended to ask for the help of Lan Ruoxi and Zhao Seng later.
"It's Blue Ice Lotus gang." Lan Ruoxi said abruptly. "What I don't understand is how can the Blue Ice Lotus gang did all this?"
Then they traveled toward Xiao Tian's company.
When Shi Fei, Lin Xing Xue, and Lan Ruoxi saw the expression on Xiao Tian's face, they knew that he wanted to go to Blue Ice Lotus headquarters.
"Tch! I don't know why master sends me to help someone like you." the green-haired man looked at Feng Ao and said in an unfriendly voice.

The green-haired man looked at Feng Ao and said, "My job is only to protect you, not to help you solve your problem. You should be grateful that my master had helped you. Otherwise, you would remain in prison now."
"Yes. That's right. It's a blue lotus." the employee said.
"One of them was wearing a glove with lotus pattern on it." the employee said.
"Yes. I don't know too."
Because Xiao Tian didn't see Shi Fei, he immediately asked, "Where is Shi Fei?"
When Lin Xing Xue saw Lan Ruoxi, she was curious about who Lan Ruoxi was, and how she could come together with Xiao Tian.

"It's because I helped him in the past. Why didn't you help me beat Xiao Tian earlier?" Feng Ao was sure the green-haired man next to him was ex-military personnel, so if he helped him earlier, Feng Ao believed that they could beat Xiao Tian.
"Hello, my name is Lin Xing Xue." because Lan Ruoxi introduced herself, Lin Xing Xue did the same.

"No. Even though it's a gang, but from the information, Blue Ice Lotus gang was built to protect women, not to hurt others. This is the first time I have heard that Blue Ice Lotus gang did something like this." Lan Ruoxi found it hard to believe that the people who injured Xiao Tian's employees were Blue Ice Lotus gang. She even suspected that someone wanted to slander Blue Ice Lotus gang.
Because Xiao Tian was not in the mood to flirt, he only looked at Lan Ruoxi and didn't say a single word.

"Someone is causing trouble at my company, and they have injured almost of my employees." Xiao Tian's eyes gleamed with terrifying sharpness as he said that. "Lady Lan, I have to return to the company."
"Yes. Thank you." Feng Ao said.
"I will be there soon." Xiao Tian's face darkened. He was furious. He didn't expect that someone would make trouble at his company today.
Lan Rouxi then brought her face closer toward Xiao Tian's right ear and whispered, "Do you like older women?"
Xiao Tian sighed in relief when he knew nothing had happened to Shi Fei too. Luckily Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei went to Stars shop earlier; otherwise, they would get injured too.
Suddenly one of the employees said, "I know something, Sir."
Because Lin Xing Xue was in front of her, Lan Ruoxi immediately noticed when Lin Xing Xue was staring at her. "Hello, I'm Lan Ruoxi."
"Lotus?" Shi Fei was a little shocked after hearing that. "Does the lotus on the glove have a blue color?"
Xiao Tian, who was standing in front of his employees, asked, "Do any of you know who did all this?"
After they arrived at his company, Xiao Tian saw almost all of his employees were injured. This made Xiao Tian grit his teeth.
This is what I lack right now. I have no underlings. This is why I have to make my company much bigger as soon as possible. Xiao Tian thought to himself.
"Young master Xiao. We should take them to the hospital first." Lan Ruoxi said abruptly.
Xiao Tian was furious and gritted his teeth. He wanted to find that person immediately, but he knew it was not the right time to do that because he had to bring his employees to the hospital first.
Lin Xing Xue was surprised when Xiao Tian suddenly appeared on her right side. "I'm fine because I went to Stars shop earlier."
"Yes. Because all of them wore black clothes and hid their faces with masks."
Xiao Tian suddenly thought of someone who was most likely the mastermind of everything that happened in his company.
Xiao Tian looked at Lan Ruoxi for three seconds before finally nodding his head, "All right."
"She is on her way to the company." Lin Xing Xue answered instantly. "Earlier, she and I went to Stars shop, but because there was something that she had to do, I returned to the company first."

Xiao Tian immediately looked for Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei because he wanted to know their condition. Because almost all of his employees were injured, Xiao Tian was afraid that something had happened to them too.
"That's right, little brother." Shi Fei also agreed with Lan Ruoxi's suggestion. She didn't want anything to happen to Xiao Tian. That was why she tried to stop Xiao Tian too.

From the way, Xiao Tian cared about Lin Xing Xue, or the way he called her, Lan Ruoxi knew that Lin Xing Xue was one of Xiao Tian's women. She just didn't expect that his woman was much older than him.
I'm sure his company is already in trouble right now. Feng Ao thought to himself.
Without waiting for another second, Xiao Tian took his smartphone out of his pocket and called an ambulance.
At this moment, Xiao Tian realized that he was powerless. "All right."

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - Beat Them To Death!
paragraphs: Not long after that, several ambulance cars arrived at Xiao Tian's company. However, it wasn't only an ambulance car that came to his company, but four police cars also came.

Jing Jing, along with several other police, got out of the car and walked toward Xiao Tian and the others. "Good afternoon, Sir. We've received information that several people have caused problems at your company and also injure your employees. We came here to collect information about it. Please cooperate with us so that we can help you resolve the problem."
Somewhere at Rainbow Garden
The members of Blue Ice Lotus gang were annoyed by Shi Fei's words. Without waiting for another second, one of the members said, "Beat them to death!"
The woman who was consuming the food immediately rose from her seat and left the restaurant.
After Shi Fei said that, seven of her underlings began to attack the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang. However, a blue-haired woman suddenly tried to attack Shi Fei.
Bang!
When Xiao Tian saw several cops in his company, he was unhappy because, with this, the problem would become bigger, and media would know what was happening at his company.
After several minutes, five cars arrived at Shi Fei apartment.
There was a two-meter high iron fence with a wall that surrounded the building. Not only that, but the building also had a large front yard.
However, Xiao Tian could do nothing because the one who informed his mother and aunt was none other than Lin Xing Xue.
"Alright." the woman, who was sitting in the driver's seat, nodded her head.
After the woman read the message, she immediately left the zoo.

That was why when they were on the way to the hospital, Lin Xing Xue secretly informed his mother and aunt because she was afraid that something would happen to Xiao Tian if he went to Blue Ice Lotus gang headquarters.
Shi Fei's kick made the door open

When Zhao Sheng heard the news about Xiao Tian's company, he immediately traveled to the hospital. Actually, Zhao Sheng wanted to inform Xiao Tian that someone had released Feng Ao from prison. He just didn't expect that someone had caused trouble at Xiao Tian's company.
Bang!
When Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng wanted to go to Blue Ice Lotus gang headquarters, suddenly Ye Qingyu and Ye Xueyin arrived at the hospital.

"Bi Yu, I have loved you since we met two years ago, but I didn't dare to say it. Now I can't hold back my feeling anymore, so I have to say it now. Bu Yu, I love you. Will you be my lover?" the young man looked at Bi Yu while hoping she would accept his love.
"How dare they do that to the company where I work for." Shi Fei took her smartphone and called someone. "Bring twenty people to my apartment right now."
Somewhere at the coffee shop.
'A message?'

Instead of blocking or avoiding the attack, Shi Fei kept walking forward without caring about it at all. Before a blue-haired woman could land a hit on Shi Fei's body, one of Shi Fei's underlings blocked it and immediately did counter-attack.
Blue Ice Lotus Headquarters was located in the southeastern part of the Nanli District. Even though it was a gang, but the headquarters was like a house of rich people.
After the woman read the message, she immediately rose from her seat and left.
As soon as Shi Fei and others stepped into the front yard, twenty members of Blue Ice Lotus gang, who were guarding the building, stood in front of them.
"Where is Shi Fei?" Xiao Tian inquired.
'A message?'
The blue-haired woman immediately fainted.
Somewhere at the zoo
"She went somewhere because she still has something to do." Lin Xing Xue answered instantly.
The young man had a sad expression on his face when Bi Yu suddenly left him alone.

Even though it was a good thing because the police would help him with the problem, it could have a harmful impact on his company, especially for the people who have ordered clothing design at his company. However, Xiao Tian was unable to do anything about it and could only cooperate with them.
"Teach them a lesson!" Shi Fei walked forward without caring about anything as if she was walking in the front yard alone.
Shi Fei kicked the iron fence until it opened.

With the help of Lin Xing Xue and his employees, Xiao Tian was able to answer all the questions from the police. After the police conducted an investigation, Xiao Tian and the others went to the hospital.
Lin Xing Xue knew that if his mother and aunt came to the hospital, Xiao Tian would not go to Blue Ice Lotus gang headquarters.
"I see." even though Xiao Tian had no idea why Shi Fei suddenly went somewhere, he didn't ask anymore because there was something more important to do.
When Shi Fei and thirteen of her underlings were in front of the door, she immediately kicked the door.
Somewhere in the apartment.
There were a young man and woman. The young woman had an adorable face while the young man had quite a handsome face.
There was a sexy mature lady with katana in her right hand. However, katana in the right hand of the sexy lady had something different on it.
The expression on her face was so frightening that it could frighten many people when they saw it. The sexy mature lady was wearing black jacket and trousers. That lady was none other than Shi Fei.
'I got...rejected?'
Ye Qingyu and Ye Xueyin were shocked after hearing several people were making trouble at Xiao Tian's company and injuring his employees.
"Understood, leader." a female voice rang out through Shi Fei's smartphone.
Bang!
Somewhere at beach
"Who are you?" one of the Blue Ice Lotus members gang said.
'A message?'
There was a small black iron chain that tied the sheath with the handle part of katana as if the wielder was not allowed to unsheathed that katana.
"Who dares to make trouble in Blue Ice Lotus gang?" one of the members shouted loudly.
The woman, who was enjoying the beautiful sea, immediately rose to her feet and left.
Bi Yu immediately rose from her seat after reading the message. Without saying a single word, she left.
"You don't deserve to know who I am." Shi Fei said coldly.
"How dare ant like you try to attack our leader!" one of Shi Fei's other underlings looked at blue-haired woman coldly before finally, she kicked the head of a blue-haired woman.
Without waiting for another second, Shi Fei got into one of the cars and said, "Let's go to Blue Ice Lotus gang."
Not long after that, they reached their destination.
They thought Xiao Tian was also injured. For this reason, they went straight to the hospital after hearing the news.
Somewhere at the restaurant
After hitting the blue-haired woman, Shi Fei's underling immediately walked on her right side again. Blue haired woman fell to the ground after being hit by Shi Fei's underling.
Xiao Tian was unhappy when his mother and aunt come to the hospital because, with that, he was unable to go to Blue Ice Lotus gang headquarters.
"That's me." Shi Fei said coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - I Will Let You Handle This
paragraphs: Shi Fei and her underlings entered the building. The room was huge, with many red sofas arranged facing to each other. However, there was one sofa that has a different color.
That sofa had a blue color and was located at the middle-end of the room. On the blue couch, a woman was sitting on it with a woman standing on both of her sides.
Chun Hua gritted her teeth after hearing Shi Fei's words. She was furious that Shi Fei kept calling her weak or ant. For this reason, she began to attack Shi Fei again.
However, she was much slower than Shi Fei. As a result, Shi Fei was already in front of her and attacked her head. Luckily she was able to block the attack with her hands.
"Bring all the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang here." Shi Fei spoke and paused for a second before she continued, "For the members who fainted, wake them up."
Chun Hua finally realized that she was very weak because if Shi Fei unsheathed her sword, she would have died right now. Chun Hua fell to her knees.
"Oh! What if I don't do that?" like before, the leader of the gang said as she smiled.
"She didn't know what she had done."

However, the result was still the same. Shi Fei could avoid or block all her attacks easily. But what made her angrier was that she was unable to land a hit on Shi Fei's body since they began to fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - All Of Them Are Useless!
paragraphs: All the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang were dumbfounded. They found it hard to believe what they were hearing.

None of them knew about the founder because she had retired from the gang nine years ago. They only knew that the founder of the gang was a very strong woman because when the founder was the leader of the gang, Blue Ice Lotus gang was the strongest gang in Nanli district.

"We will meet Xiao Tian and apologize to him tomorrow. I don't want the founder to torture us." Chun Hua had no idea what would happen to them if Shi Fei really tortured them. But what she believed was that it would be something that they hoped never happen to them in their lives.
"That's right. All of them are useless! How can they take orders from unknown people?" Bi Yu agreed to Fu Ji's words.
I will try to find out later. Shi Fei thought to herself.
Shi Fei then looked at Chun Hua and said, "What generation of leader are you from?"

"And from tomorrow onwards, all of you have to follow his every word. If he wants you all to slap your faces, then all of you should slap your faces. Do you all understand?" Shi Fei thought it was the best punishment for them. With this, not only was Xiao Tian able to let out all of his anger, but he would get underlings too. This would greatly help him in the future.

In the past, Blue Ice Lotus gang was the strongest gang. Even several upper-class families had to think twice if they wanted to cause trouble for them. However, now their gang had turned into a useless group with weakling members.
"Fourth-generation." Chun Hua answered while shivering. The pressure when she looked at Shi Fei was too overwhelming until it made her afraid to look at Shi Fei in the eyes.

At this moment, Lan Ruoxi could only sigh. She knew Xiao Tian wouldn't hear anything, she said. Actually, she believed Shi Fei had solved the problem. But she didn't say anything about it because she knew Shi Fei didn't want Xiao Tian to know Shi Fei's real identity.

At this moment, Shi Fei was thinking about what kind of punishment she should give to her members' gang. After thinking for a while, she found the right punishment for them. "Tomorrow, I want all of you to meet Xiao Tian and apologize to him. Whatever he wants to do to you all, all of you are not allowed to fight back. Otherwise, I will come again and punish you all myself. Believe me. you don't want it."
"Right now." Xiao Tian said.
"Yes, founder." all the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang said in unison.
"I built this gang to protect women, not to hurt innocent people!" Shi Fei shouted angrily. "Why did all of you disobey our mottos?"
"Yes. I'm sure about it. Only the first-generation has the strength like them." at this moment, Chun Hua didn't know whether she should happy or not.
When Shi Fei left, one of the gang members said, "Leader, are they from first-generation?"
"Why did you ignore the rules that I made?" Shi Fei asked coldly.
But since the founder left the gang, Blue Ice Lotus gang slowly became weaker and weaker. Now almost all upper-class families could order them around.
"What should we do now?" one of the members asked.
How can young master Zhao not know who Shi Fei is? Lan Ruoxi thought to herself.
When the members of the gang heard what Shi Fei had said, they shivered. From the rumor, when the devil queen tortured people, they would rather die than continue to be tortured by her.

Chun Hua was pleased because they could ask their founder for help if they faced something they couldn't handle in the future. But she was sad because, from today onwards, they had to follow every word of Xiao Tian.
"Leader, what should we do now?" Bi Yu, who was standing on Shi Fei's left side, asked.
"Sigh. This is because all our gang members in this generation are useless." Fu Jiyi, who was standing on Shi Fei's right side, said abruptly.

"Founder, since you left the gang, our gang become weaker and weaker. Now, almost all upper-class families can order us around." Chun Hua gave Shi Fei an honest answer. "At first, I didn't want to accept their order. However, because the upper-class families who support the gang no longer care about us, we have no choice but to agree to take the order. Otherwise, they will kill us. They came to us with several people, and each of them was equipped with weapons and military costumes. With that, we know that they are from upper-class families because it is impossible for middle-class families to have bodyguards like that."
"We don't know." Chun Hua shook her head. "When we asked about it, they didn't give us an answer, saying that it was not our business."
In the Hospital Garden.

"Xiao Tian, I've brought ten people with me." Zhao Sheng said while pointing his index finger toward the people behind them. "Each one of them can fight with more than ten people, so this is more than enough to destroy Blue Ice Lotus gang. When will we go?"
So, they don't want to get their hands dirty, huh? Shi Fei thought to herself.
"Oh, right. I'm working under him too, so every time you all see me next to him, you all have to call me by name." Shi Fei then rose from the couch, "Let's go."
All the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang knew about the mottos, but since the founder left the gang, the next generation of the gang slowly began to ignore it.

At this moment, Shi Fei didn't know should she blame them or not. She knew that they were powerless now, but to hurt innocent people was out of their mottos. "Why did they want to cause trouble for Stars Clothes company?"
"All right. Let's move now." Zhao Sheng replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - Who Are They?
paragraphs: "Oh, right! Here, take this. This wooden sword is special. It's made from a special tree, so it's hard to break this wooden sword. Have you learned sword martial art before?" Zhao Sheng gave the wooden sword to Xiao Tian.
Before Zhao Sheng returned home to bring his people, Xiao Tian asked him to bring a wooden sword. At first, he was surprised, but he suddenly thought that Xiao Tian had learned sword martial art.
"Mr. Xiao Tian. We are sorry for what we had done to your company and employees. We are forced to do that." Chun Hua said while bowing toward Xiao Tian.
Xiao Tian then returned his attention to Chun Hua and asked, "Who asked you to cause trouble at my company?"
With an angry face, Xiao Tian grabbed Chun Hua by the neck and looked at her. "Do you think the words of apology are enough?"
"We don't...know. They were...wearing masks....when they....came to us." at this moment, Chun Hua's face had turned blue because Xiao Tian was still grabbing her neck.
Xiao Tian took the wooden sword and swung it several times. The weight, length, and size were perfect for him. Xiao Tian was satisfied with the wooden sword, "Yes. Let's go now."

The corner of Zhao Sheng's lips twitched upon hearing her words. Zhao Sheng knew why Lan Ruoxi looked at him while saying that. That was because she beat him in the past. However, Zhao Sheng was sure if they fought again, he would win fight against her.
Xiao Tian didn't remember that he had someone who would help him besides Zhao Sheng and Lan Ruoxi. So, he was curious who had helped him.

"We also...don't know...they..were wearing masks.... They told us....to be your underling....or else....they would.....come and....beat us again." because Shi Fei told them not to reveal her identity to Xiao Tian, Chun Hua had no choice but to lie to Xiao Tian.
"All right." because Lan Ruoxi is a master of martial arts, Xiao Tian let her do whatever she wanted.

"I think making them your underling is better than destroying them." even though Blue Ice Lotus gang had caused trouble at Xiao Tian's company, Zhao Sheng thought it would better to make them Xiao as Tian's underling because it would be more beneficial for Xiao Tian in the future.
Zhao Sheng then walked closer toward Xiao Tian and said, "What are you going to do to them?"
'Who are they?'

"We...we are forced...to do that..if we didn't ...do...that.. they will...kill...us. As a sign...of apologize for.. what we.....have done...we...will...follow...your every word from....today onwards." because Xiao Tian was grabbing her neck, Hun Chua had difficulty finishing her words.
"What is this? Are you worried about me? Just for information, I'm an expert in martial arts, you know." Then Lan Ruoxi looked at Zhao Sheng. "Isn't that right, young master Zhao?"
"Good!" Xiao Tian was pleased after hearing her words. "Let's go now."
This dumbfounded Xiao Tian. Earlier, he had prepared to fight them. He just didn't expect that all the members of the gang had been injured.
At this moment, all of the members of the gang sank to their knees. They didn't expect Xiao Tian would come to their headquarters immediately.
"Send the location to me now." after her subordinate sent the location of Feng Ao's whereabouts, Lan Ruoxi walked toward Xiao Tian. "Young master Xiao, my people have found Feng Ao's whereabouts."

Then they went to the headquarters of Blue Ice Lotus gang. However, when they stepped into the building, what Lan Ruoxi had guessed was right because all of the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang had been injured.
"What about them?" Zhao Sheng inquired.
"That's right, young master Xiao. I agree with young master Zhao's idea." Lan Ruoxi added.
"My lady, we have found Feng Ao's whereabouts." a female's voice rang out through Lan Ruoxi's smartphone.
"I will think about it later." Xiao Tian was thinking about what he should do to them. That was why he still hasn't decided whether he would destroy Blue Ice Lotus gang or not.
When Xiao Tian was walking, he suddenly stopped his footsteps and turned around. "Lady Lan, you don't need to follow us. You can go home now."

Xiao Tian was thinking about the best choices between destroying them or having them as his underling. "Why do you all suddenly want to be my underling? And what happened to your gang? Who beat up your gang?"
"Well, I'm curious about Blue Ice Lotus gang. So, I will go with you." of course, Lan Ruoxi was lying to Xiao Tian because she knew all about Blue Ice Lotus gang.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - I Will Torture Him From Inside
paragraphs: Somewhere inside the house.
A middle-aged man was sitting on the couch in the living room. In the living room, there was only a sofa with a table in front of it.
'From the information, young master Xiao has never learned martial arts before, but his movement earlier was.... Wait! Is the information wrong?'
"Hahaha." Zhao Sheng laughed after hearing Xiao Tian's words. As a playboy, Zhao Sheng understood what Xiao Tian meant by torturing Feng Ao from inside. "That's a brilliant idea."
"Good!" Lan Ruoxi answered instantly.
Zhao Sheng looked at Lan Ruoxi and said, "Big sister Lan, believe me. You won't want to know what Xiao Tian will do to Feng Ao."
Because Zhao Sheng understood Xiao Tian's words, she immediately asked, "Young master Zhao, can you tell me about it? I don't understand about it at all."
When Feng Ao saw Zhao Sheng, the expression of deep shock appeared on his face. He didn't expect Xiao Tian would come with Zhao Sheng.
"Understood, young master." Zhao Sheng's people immediately went to close all escape routes, leaving only one person behind Zhao Sheng. "Mo Lian, open the door."
"Oh! Look like you are smarter than I thought." Xiao Tian didn't try to deny it because there was no point to do so.
"Mr. Feng, there is still me here." at this moment, it was Lan Ruoxi's turn to enter the living room.
Feng Ao cursed venomously in his heart.
Because Zhao Sheng didn't want Feng Ao to escape, he looked at his people and said, "Block all escape routes."
"Yo, Feng Ao, I also came." Zhao Sheng suddenly stepped into the living room with a smile on his face.

Lan Ruoxi was surprised when she saw Xiao Tian's movement earlier. His move was like the movement of someone who had learned martial art for many years. However, her people said that Xiao Tian had never learned martial arts before.
This greatly surprised Feng Ao. He didn't expect Xiao Tian had two prominent supporters. This was different from what he had planned.
Xiao Tian looked at Feng Ao and said, "Stupid!"
At this moment, Feng Ao was pleased because Xiao Tian was standing in front of him alone. "I didn't expect you can find this place. However, you made a mistake of coming here alone."
At this moment, Feng Ao still didn't want to admit that Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng were friends. However, he didn't know why Zhao Sheng decided to help Xiao Tian.
However, Zhao Sheng said nothing and only looked at her. Zhao Sheng then looked at Xiao Tian and asked, "When will you do that?"
"Yo, Feng Ao. We meet again." Xiao Tian walked towards Feng Ao and stopped in front of him. "Why are you hiding in a small place like this?"
'Wait! Don't tell me. They are friends?!'
Xiao Tian thought for several seconds before finally, he started to smirk. "I will torture him from inside."
At this moment, Xiao Tian and the others were not far from the house.
Without waiting for another second, Mo Lian took something from her pocket to unlock the door. Mo Lian nodded her head when he managed to open the door.
'Why did the Zhao family's young master come with him? Do they know each other?'
'Shit! With Zhao Sheng here, the green-haired man will not help me because his master's family is not an opponent of the Zhao family, so I'm sure he will remain hidden. Fuck!'

From the expression when he saw the pictures, anyone could tell that he hated the person on the photos to the bone as if killing them was the only reason that makes him stay alive. That middle-aged man was none other than Feng Ao.

"I will send one of my people to take you to my hotel. You can do it at my hotel. Haha. "actually, Zhao Sheng wanted to know Feng Ao's expression later. However, because he knew what Xiao Tian would do, he decided not to follow Xiao Tian.

"You are related to what had happened to my company, right?" Xiao Tian suspected that Feng Ao was related to what had happened to his company and employees. That was why Xiao Tian said that to Feng Ao.
Feng Ao fell to the floor. He was coughing nonstop while holding his neck. His eyes turned white, and saliva dripped down from the corner of his mouth.

"No wonder. It's no wonder you can destroy my family in a single day. It seems like I'm still one step behind you. I didn't expect you have two powerful supporters." at this moment, Feng Ao knew that he was doomed. He believed the people of Lan Ruoxi and Zhao Sheng had sealed all escape routes.
Feng Ao took beer in front of him and drank it. "Xiao Tian, do you like my gift? Haha. Soon, I will send you to Yama king, and after that, it will be Da Gui's turn."
Before Feng Ao could land his fist on Xiao Tian's body, Xiao Tian thrust the wooden sword in his hands towards Feng Ao's neck.
Feng Ao was curious why Zhao Sheng appeared in front of him.
When two of Lan Ruoxi's people saw them, they immediately walked toward them. One of them immediately said, "My lady. The target is inside this house."
However, there was a picture of Xiao Tian and Da Gui hanging on the wall with a small knife in the middle of it.

After remembering what had happened to him since he left Red Flower Bar, Feng Ao understood something. He then laughed loudly and said, "Haha. Now I understand everything. From the beginning, all of you work together to destroy my family, right?"
They immediately entered the house and began to look for Feng Ao. When they heard Feng Ao's laughter in the living room, all of them nodded their heads.
Uakk!

Feng Ao wanted to believe that Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng were friends. However, Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng were from different class families, so Feng Ao found it hard to believe that they were friends because usually, upper-class family members only befriend with family members who were equals to them.
"I don't know what you mean by that, but die." even though Feng Ao knew that he was doomed today, but he didn't want to give up without trying anything. That was why he decided to attack Xiao Tian.
"I didn't expect a young master from the famous family will help someone from middle-class family?" Feng Ao said as he looked at Zhao Sheng.
Lan Ruoxi became even more curious after hearing Zhao Sheng's words. "Tell me! I want to know too."
"Whoa! Nice move, Xiao Tian!" Zhao Sheng said while patting Xiao Tian's shoulders. "So, what are you going to do to him now?"
"What do you mean by that, young master Xiao?" Lan Ruoxi asked curiously. She had no idea the meaning of Xiao Tian's words. That was why she asked him, hoping that Xiao Tian would tell her about it.
'No. Maybe they are not friends. Maybe Xiao Tian asked Zhao Sheng for help. But why does Zhao Sheng help him?'
"After we leave this place!" Xiao Tian answered instantly.
"Good!" Xiao Tian then hit the backside of Feng Ao's neck, causing Feng Ao to faint instantly.

Xiao Tian didn't want to tell them that he went to Blue Ice Lotus gang headquarters because he knew that they would get angry if he told them about it.
"Don't tell me, the mastermind behind everything that happens to your company are people who has a business in the same field as you.

They did all of this because your company is developing rapidly and taking many of their customers." Ye Qinyu had no idea why she suddenly had thoughts like this, but she was unable to find a better reason.
Then Xiao Tian, his mother, and aunt talked until 11:30 pm before finally, they headed toward Xiao Tian's room and slept.
After Xiao Tian arrived at Red Flower Bar, he told Lan Ruoxi's people that he wanted to meet her.
One of them immediately guided Xiao Tian to a special guest room before heading toward Lan Rouxi's room.
"No." Xiao Tian shook his head.
"I don't even know who they are."
Because Xiao Tian wanted to know whether Lan Ruoxi had gotten information about who freed Feng Ao from prison or not, he went straight to the Red Flower Bar.
To his surprise, when Xiao Tian reached his company, the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang were already waiting for his arrival.
And like yesterday, they all wore regular clothes as if they were not members of the gang.
"I think so too." from what he had experienced in his past live, Xiao Tian had some suspicions about who was the mastermind behind everything that happened at his company.
"I'm home, mother." Xiao Tian smiled before walking toward the couch and putting his mother on it.
Of course, Xiao Tian didn't tell his employees that the people who guarded them were a gang that caused problems at his company.
First, it was Feng Ao who paid the gang.
Second, it was a person who supported Feng Ao.
And the last, it was a person who had a business in the same field as him.
Because there was nothing to discuss anymore, Xiao Tian told them to leave before he entered the company and began to work.
Even though Xiao Tian had no idea how they could make the police stop the investigation, Xiao Tian was pleased by it because with that, his company could return to normal again.
"All right." Xiao Tian nodded his head as he smiled.
Xiao Tian was only able to guess who they were and could only wait for Lan Ruoxi to give him information about them later.
Of course, Xiao Tian would hire a professional bodyguard or assassin too in the future because, in his view, having Blu Ice Lotus gang as his underling was still not enough.
Even though they still disliked him, but after hearing his words, the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang had a better view of him.
At this moment, Xiao Tian felt lucky that when the members of Blue Ice Lotus gang caused trouble at his company, they hid their faces with masks.
Otherwise, Xiao Tian would not be able to make them guarding his company openly.
If Xiao Tian kept forcing them to follow his every word without treating them nicely, he knew that they would stab him from behind sooner or later.
Previously, Xiao Tian told the members of the gang who guarded the company to be divided into two teams.
One was to guard them openly, and the other was to defend them in secret.
And like what she usually did, when Ye Xueyin was in front of her son, she immediately jumped into his arms and said, "Tian, welcome home."
Even though Ye Qinyu was still curious about it, but because Xiao Tian didn't want to tell her, she decided not to ask anymore.
Instead of immediately giving her an answer, Xiao Tian kissed her lips and sat on her left side.
"I had something important to do."
'Luckily, Lan Ruoxi and Zhao Sheng have talked to the police.'
Xiao Tian also told them that they could stay in their headquarters, but if he needed them, they had to help him immediately.
"Tian, you have to be careful from now on." Ye Xueyin was afraid that something like this would happen again in his company.
Luckily, Xiao Tian was away when those people caused trouble at his company; otherwise, she believed that her son would get injure too.
I can't always depend on them.
Xiao Tian thought to himself.
Xiao Tian knew that they disliked him very much.
They became his underling because someone would beat them to death if they didn't do so.
Xiao Tian told them that because they were his underling now, they had to guard his company and shop every day in secret and immediately reported to him if there was anything suspicious.
Even though there were only a few employees working today, Xiao Tian didn't mind it.
At least his company could still produce clothing design.
"Tian, why did those people cause trouble at your company?
Did you make trouble with them?" Ye Xeuyin asked abruptly.
Of course, Xiao Tian would also give them the facility later.
Xiao Tian promised them that as long as they were loyal and followed his words, he would give them better equipment and treat them nicely.
Xiao Tian understood that having an unfaithful underling meant nothing.
It would be even more dangerous to people who were important to him, so Xiao Tian wanted to make them his loyal underling.
The following morning, Xiao Tian went straight to his company after having breakfast with his mother and aunt because he wanted to wait for Blue Ice Lotus gang to come to his company.
However, Xiao Tian was annoyed at the same time because every time he had trouble, he needed the help of Zhao Sheng or Lan Ruoxi.
Because Xiao Tian didn't want other people to know about them, he brought them to the company backyard.
The members of Blue Ice Lotus gang were shocked after hearing his words.
Earlier, they thought Xiao Tian would only give them orders without caring about them.
Earlier, Xiao Tian had decided to make Blue Ice Lotus gang as his underling so that they could protect his company and store in the future.
Ye Qingyu, who was watching TV, turned her head toward her nephew and asked, "Where did you go earlier?"
'I hope none of them will betray me later.
I will make them loyal to me sooner or later.'
Not long after Xiao Tian sat on the couch, a beautiful mature lady entered the special guest room.
"Young master Xiao, what brings you here today?"

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - Because You Are A Devil In Disguise
paragraphs: "I want to know whether you have gotten the information about who released Feng Ao from prison or not." Xiao Tian went straight to the point
Like usual, Lan Ruoxi sat on Xiao Tian's lap and looked at him, "Of course, I have gotten the information about it. Did you doubt my ability?"
The deep feeling of surprise emerged on her face. Lan Ruoxi's eyes widened in shock. She didn't expect Xiao Tian would suddenly kiss her.
"So, what did you do to Feng Ao before putting him in the Zhao family prison?" Because Xiao Tian didn't tell her about it, she decided to ask again.
"No." Xiao Tian shook his head. "Can you not sit on my lap right now?"
"Good!" In her view, it would be better not to make enemies with upper-class families because that could have fatal consequences for Xiao Tian's company or people who were important to him.
'Yes. Because you are a devil in disguise.'
"Do you know why he helped Feng Ao?" Xiao Tian inquired.
"Why didn't he help Feng Ao when we destroyed Feng Ao's company?" Xiao Tian was curious why Ming Sha didn't help Feng Ao when he and the others caused trouble at Feng Ao's company.
Lan Ruoxi suddenly remembered something. For this reason, she immediately asked, "Young master Xiao, what did you do to Feng Ao? And where is he now?"

Xiao Tian had no idea as to why Lan Ruoxi always sat on his lap whenever he came to meet her. In their first meeting, she didn't behave like that, but after he agreed not to kill Liu Ning, Lan Ruoxi began to act wildly as if she always wanted to lovey-dovey with him or make him hers.

Lan Ruoxi had never thought that they would bring Feng Ao to the Zhao family prison. Rumors said, if someone was put in the Zhao family's prison, they would never come out unless the member of the Zhao family freed that person or God had taken that person's life.
"It's Ming Sha." Lan Ruoxi answered instantly. "He is from an upper-class family. He owned several restaurants and hotels."
To his surprise, Lan Ruoxi did nothing and let him do whatever he wanted. This made Xiao Tian wonder. Because there was no point in kissing her anymore, Xiao Tian decided to stop the kiss.
Lan Ruoxi answered instantly in her mind.
Lan Ruoxi immediately giggled and said, "Hehe. What is this? Why did you suddenly kiss my lips? Do you feel aroused because a beautiful, sexy woman is sitting on your lap?"
And here, she always sat on his lap every time they met. This made Xiao Tian curious and put his guard up whenever he was with her.
Xiao Tian didn't expect that Lan Ruoxi still wanted to know what he had done to Feng Ao. But because he thought it would be better for her not to know about it, Xiao Tian didn't say a single word.
"Do you not want me to sit on your lap?" Lan Ruoxi made a sad expression as if he had hurt her feelings. "I like sitting on your lap, so I will continue doing this."
Lan Ruoxi then brought her face closer toward Xiao Tian's right ear and whispered, "If you want, we can go to my room now, you know."
"In the past, Feng Ao helped his son when his company rival kidnapped his son." Lan Ruoxi answered instantly.
Xiao Tian didn't stop the kiss and kept pressing his lips against hers because he wanted to know what she would do later.
"Let put this conversation aside." Xiao Tian decided to change the topic. "So, who is it?"
Xiao Tian looked into her eyes for three seconds before finally asking, "Are you trying to seduce me?"
Even though Xiao Tian would love to have sex with Lan Ruoxi, but at that time, he was not in the mood to do that because he only wanted to know the person who had helped Feng Ao.
Because Xiao Tian wanted to know why she always tried to get close to him, he decided to test her. Then Xiao Tian grabbed her by the chin and kissed her lips.

As he was kissing her, Xiao Tian looked into her eyes because he wanted to know about her reaction. It said that people could see other people's feelings through their eyes. That was why when Xiao Tian was kissing Lan Ruoxi, he looked at her in the eyes.
Lan Ruoxi was disappointed when Xiao Tian still didn't want to tell her about it, but she could do nothing, so she gave up on it.

And that only valid to family members who had a strong influence on the family. For family members who didn't have an influence on the family, they didn't have such privileges. They were not even allowed to enter prison.
"Yes. Especially when I see your pretty lips." Xiao Tian still clearly felt the softness of her lips. That was why he suddenly wanted to kiss her again, but he decided not to do so.

Because Xiao Tian wanted to know whether Ming Sha was related to everything that happened at his company or not, he immediately called Chun Hua. "Keep an eye on Ming Sha. And if he does something suspicious, inform me immediately."

Even though Xiao Tian knew Lan Ruoxi often used sweet words to people who had an important status in Shanghai, but according to information from her people, none of them could touch her body because, in her eyes, none of them were worthy of touching her body.

I will make the members of the gang keep an eye on him. If he is related to what has happened in my company, I don't care whether he is from an upper-class family or not. I will make him pay a hundred times. Xiao Tian thought to himself.
Because Lan Ruoxi didn't ask her people to follow them, she didn't know what Xiao Tian had done to Feng Ao or where they had taken Feng Ao.
Instead of giving him an answer, Lan Ruoxi asked him. "What do you think?"
Lan Ruoxi knew that Zhao Sheng had the privilege to enter the prison because he was a genius in martial arts. Zhao Sheng's grandfather even treated him, specially.

"Maybe because he was not in China." Lan Ruoxi answered. From the information, Ming Sha was abroad with his family, when they were causing trouble at Feng Ao's company. "Do you want to cause trouble at his company?"
"Zhao family prison?" Lan Ruoxi said in surprise.
This was also one of the reasons why Xiao Tian never tried to seduce Lan Ruoxi, too, because he wanted to know what kind of woman she was. Why did she always want to get close to him?
"He is in Zhao family prison." Xiao Tian gave an honest answer. "It's better if you don't know what I did to him."

"What do you mean by that? Why should I make trouble at his company? I just want to know who helped Feng Ao get out of prison and investigate him. If that person doesn't do anything bad to me, I will do the same." Xiao Tian had the principle that if someone never made trouble to him, he would do the same thing, but if someone caused him trouble, he would destroy that person. "Am I really that bad in your eyes?"
"Understood." Chun Hua answered.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - Why Did You Always Buy Chocolate?
paragraphs: After Xiao Tian left Red Flower Bar, he traveled to the University Garden to meet Zhao Sheng. They talked for several minutes before finally, Xiao Tian suddenly wanted to see Feng Ao.
Because Xiao Tian would not be able to enter the Zhao family prison alone, Zhao Sheng accompanied Xiao Tian to see Feng Ao.
With that on his mind, Xiao Tian decided to buy something else the next time he came to their home.
She just hoped her daughter would accept their relationship quickly so that she didn't have to wait for Feng Yu to sleep or when Feng Yu was not at home only to lovey-dovey with him.
"Yo, Feng Ao. I've come to see you." Xiao Tian said when he was in front of Feng Ao.
Xiao Tian knocked on the door with a smile on his face.

And what Lin Xing Xue had guessed was right because when Xiao Tian saw Feng Yu, he immediately stopped hugging her and didn't try to kiss her anymore. Lin Xing Xue almost laughed when she saw the corner of his lips twitching.

"Xiao Tian, you should buy other snacks the next time you come to my home. Why did you always buy chocolate? At least, buy me something else." Even though Feng Yu said that, she still took the chocolate.
Lin Xing Xue immediately giggled when Xiao Tian stopped what he was doing. At this moment, Lin Xing Xue knew that Xiao Tian would not kiss her because he always considered her daughter's feelings.

If her daughter didn't like something, Xiao Tian would not do anything that her daughter disliked. That was why Xiao Tian never kissed or hugged her whenever her daughter was with them because her daughter still hasn't accepted their relationship.

Lin Xing Xue giggled happily when Xiao Tian tried not to cry. Sometimes, she even wished that Feng Yu was always by their side because with that, she could bully him whenever she wanted, and Xiao Tian would never fight back or punish her.
After driving for several minutes, they finally arrived at the Zhao family prison.
However, when Xiao Tian was on the way to his home, he suddenly wanted to see Lin Xing Xue. For this reason, he bought many chocolates before traveling to Lin Xing Xue's house.
Xiao Tian was a little surprised after hearing her words. He didn't expect Lin Xing Xue would say something like that to him.
Not only that, they even had sex in front of him. But what he found it hard to believe was that his wife enjoyed herself very much when she was having sex with another man in front of him.
Not long after that, a beautiful mature woman opened the door. "Tian, come in."
"I know." When Xiao Tian saw the expression on Feng Ao's face, he understood that Feng Ao had reached his limit, and he would not be able to torture him anymore.
But it was reasonable because his life had been broken apart. From his company, family, and even more so, his beautiful wife now had become another man's lover.
The corner of Xiao Tian's lips twitched when Feng Yu still took the chocolate after saying something like that. But Xiao Tian realized that he should buy something else next time.
When Xiao Tian didn't see Feng Yu, he immediately grabbed Lin Xing Xue's waist and wanted to kiss her lips. However, when their lips were so close to each other, Feng Yu suddenly appeared.
Feng Ao understood that no one would help him anymore because no one wanted to be an enemy of the Zhao family.
"Young master." Several guards said in unison when they saw Zhao Sheng entering the prison.
"All right." When Lin Xin Xue noticed Xiao Tian not following them, she stopped her footsteps. "What are you doing? Let's head to the living room."
Feng Yu then grabbed her mother's right hand and said, "Mother, let's head to the living room."
With a smile on his face, Xiao Tian walked toward Feng Yu and gave the chocolates. "Little Yu, this big brother, has bought chocolates earlier. Here, take it."
Lin Xing Xue knew Xiao Tian was disappointed. That was why she brought her face closer toward his right ear and whispered, "You can hug and kiss me later when Yu'er sleeps, so don't be sad."
"Hiii." Xiao Tian tried not to cry when Lin Xing Xue suddenly pinched his waist because he had guessed that she would do something like that.
Knock...knock...knock...
'My mind is not working very well when it comes to children. Huft!'

In the prison cell, there were sink and toilet on the right side of the cell, while the mattress was located on the left side of the prison cell. Currently, Feng Ao was sitting on the floor with his back leaning against the wall.
He never made the trouble to Xiao Tian, Zhao Sheng, and Lan Ruoxi, so why did they ruin his life? That was the question he wanted to know the answer.
However, how many times he thought about it, Feng Ao was still unable to find the answer because, in his view, he had never made the trouble to them at all.
After looking at Feng Ao for about ten minutes, Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng left. Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng went to Bamboo Restaurant and talked for several minutes before they finally returned home.
Feng Ao kept looking forward expressionlessly and had no reaction when he saw Xiao Tian in front of him.
Zhao Sheng tapped Xiao Tian's shoulders and said, "He has been like this since he is in the prison cell. There is no point in torturing him anymore because he has reached his limit."
Feng Ao didn't expect that his life would get destroyed in a day. He himself even had no idea what he had done wrong? And why did it have to happen to him?
Zhao Sheng only smiled at them without saying a single word. Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng kept walking until finally, they reached the prison cell where Feng Ao was held.
But this made Lin Xing Xue happy because, with this, she knew that Xiao Tian really loved her. He even tried his best not to kiss or hug her whenever her daughter was with them.
Feng Ao ignored Xiao Tian as if he didn't know that Xiao Tian and Zhao Sheng were in front of him. At this moment, Feng Ao was like a person without a soul anymore.

Xiao Tian started to smirk when he knew Lin Xing Xue wanted him to kiss or hug her too. That was why Xiao Tian also whispered in her ears, "So, you want me to kiss and hug you, huh? How about the other thing?"
Because Feng Yu really loved chocolate, Xiao Tian thought she would be happy if he brought chocolates every time he came to their house, but he was wrong.
Everything was too much for Feng Ao to bear. He wanted to torture Xiao Tian too, but he knew that he would never be able to do that because he was now in the Zhao family's prison cell.
Even though sometimes Lin Xing Xue was a little disappointed too, but she could not do anything about it.
Upon hearing his words, Lin Xing Xue's face turned red and immediately pinched his waist. Of course, Lin Xing Xue understood what Xiao Tian meant by the other thing.
"Un." Xiao Tian nodded his head as he smiled.

At this moment, Feng Ao was like a person without a soul anymore.

That was why Xiao Tian also whispered in her ears, "So, you want me to kiss and hug you, huh?

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - Sorry For Waking You Two Up
paragraphs: After talking with Lin Xing Xue for about one and a half hours, Xiao Tian returned home because it was already 10:30 pm.
Because Xiao Tian thought his mother and aunt were sleeping, he closed and locked the door carefully before heading toward his room.
In order to make his company bigger, Xiao Tian needed to open several branches so that the company's revenue would be much bigger than before.
That was why Xiao Tian wanted to know about the company's finances before deciding how many branches they would open.
Because the company had earned so much in the past few months, Xiao Tian thought it would be better to buy the building.

Xiao Tian didn't want to open too many branches at once. He needed to know about how much profit the company had earned first because if he didn't think about it carefully and only opened many branches at once, it could backfire for him later.
"How many branches do you want to open?" Shi Fei inquired.

"Sit on the couch first. I want to discuss something with you two." After Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei sat on the couch, Xiao Tian began to explain the reason why he called them to his office. "I know there was a pretty big mess in the company two days ago, but because the employees only suffered minor injuries and almost all of them have returned to work today, I think it's time for us to talk about the company's development again."
"I want to open a few branches." because his company grew smoothly, Xiao Tian thought it was time to open branch again.
After smiling at who cute his mother's behavior was, Xiao Tian kissed her lips for three seconds before stopping the kiss. "Let's sleep again."
To his surprise, when he stepped into his room, he saw his mother and aunt sleeping deeply. Not only that, but they were even space between them as if they had prepared it for him before sleeping.
"Everything is normal, sir. He hasn't done anything suspicious until now." Chun Hua answered instantly.
"Do you need anything, little brother?" Shi Fei said when she was in front of Xiao Tian.
Because there was nothing to discuss anymore, Lin Xing Xue and Shi Fei returned to their office to work again.
"All right." Shi Fei and Lin Xing Xue said in unison.
"So?" because Xiao Tian didn't say it clearly, Shi Fei and Lin Xing Xue didn't understand what he wanted to say
After Xiao Tian changed his clothes, he crawled into the bed carefully because he didn't want to wake his mother and aunt.
When Ye Xueyin saw what her son was doing, she immediately pouted her lips and said, "Tian..."
But even so, his mother and aunt still woke up when he was about to lay on his back. With a smile on his face, Xiao Tian said, "Sorry for waking you two up."
"It's a brilliant idea because we still don't have branches in the Wanhui district." Shi Fei then looked at Lin Xing Xue. "What do you think?"
"Yes." Xiao Tian answered before kissing his aunt's forehead.
"Keep monitoring him." even though Ming Sha still hadn't done anything suspicious, Xiao Tian wanted to make sure that Ming Sha really wasn't involved in what had happened in his company.
Like what her big sister did, Ye Qingyu also did the same thing before closing her eyes. She was pleased because she could sleep while embracing her nephew's right arm.
"Where do you want to open it?" Lin Xing Xue inquired.
Xiao Tian had thought about it before, so he immediately answered, "Two branches in Beijing, two in Wanhui district. What do you think?"
Even though his mother didn't finish her words, but when Xiao Tian saw she was pouting her lips, he knew that she wanted a kiss on the lips.
Not long after that, they fell asleep.
Because Shi Fei didn't know how much profit the company had earned in the past few months, she immediately left to get the data before finally returning to Xiao Tian's office again.
"I think so too." Lin Xing Xue answered as she nodded her head.
"Understood, sir." Chun Hua answered.
"Un." Because her son had kissed her lips, Ye Xeyin immediately embraced his left arm and shut her eyes.
When Xiao Tian was alone in his office, he took his smartphone and called Chun Hua. "What are the results of the investigation?"
Instead of giving her an answer, Xiao Tian asked her, "How much profit has the company made in the last few months? And in your opinion, how many branches can we open with that money?"
"I agree with that." Shi Fe and Lin Xing Xue said in unison.

They also thought it was time to open the branch again. With the profits company has earned until now, it was more than enough to open three or four branches. So, if the company could get more profit by opening several branches, there was no reason not to open a branch.
"Tian, you have returned?" Ye Qingyu, who was on his right side, said.

"Perfect! Let's advertise it on the company's website like before, so that it can reduce production costs." Xiao Tian suddenly remembered something important. "After this, one of you goes and meets the owner of this building because the rental time is almost up. I like this place, so I want to buy this place."
When Xiao Tian read the data, he assumed that they could open four branches without affecting the company's financial condition. "Let's open four branches."
As soon as Xiao Tian was in his office, he immediately called Shi Fei and Lin Xing Xue.

The following morning, Xiao Tian went straight to the campus because he had a morning class. Like usual, Xiao Tian talked with Zhao Sheng at University Garden for several minutes before finally, he went to his company.
After that Xiao Tian hung up the phone and began to work again.
