chapters.title: Chapter 296 - Yes. I Miss You. I Really Do
paragraphs: Because Xiao Tian wanted to know whether Lan Ruoxi had gotten the information about the masterminds behind everything that happened at his company or not, he decided to call her.

"Hello, young master Xiao. You want to ask about the masterminds of the chaos that occurred in your company, right?" Xiao Tian had never called her if it was not related to information, so Lan Ruoxi knew the reason why Xiao Tian suddenly called her.
She knew Xiao Tian was good-looking and has many women. She just found it hard to believe that Xiao Tian always ignored a gorgeous lady like her.
"All right." Xiao Tian nodded his head. After they sat on the wooden bench, Xiao Tian asked, "Why did you want to meet in this place?"
Instead of blushing or feeling shy, Yun Xin Er giggled and said, "Hehe. I will not let you kiss my lips today."
Then Xiao Tian and Yun Xin Er talked about many things while holding hands. They stayed at Jinlan Lake until 05:00 pm before finally, they returned home.
With this, Xiao Tian understood that Yun Xin Er was really worried when she found out that several people had caused trouble at his company.
"Yes. I miss you. I really do." Xiao Tian then brought his face closer to her right ear. "Especially the taste of your pretty lips."
"How about now?" Yun Xin Er inquired.
"Yes." Xiao Tian answered honestly. "How is the result? Did your people discover anything?"

"No. We still don't know who they are." Lan Ruoxi's had tried their best to find out who the masterminds were, but it was always in vain. Every time they found a clue, the clue suddenly disappeared or the person who had the clue suddenly died.
Then Xiao Tian rose from his seat and headed to the parking lot. After driving for several minutes, Xiao Tian finally arrived at Jinlan Lake.
After that, Xiao Tian hung up the phone and began to work again. However, not long after that, Yun Xin Er suddenly called him. "Hello, big sister Yun."
"Let's meet at Jinlan Lake." Because they always met at Rainbow Garden, Yun Xin Er suddenly wanted to meet him at another place.
Should I ask Zhao Sheng for help? But Lan Ruoxi will get angry if I do that because I have agreed to let her handle it. Xiao Tian thought to himself.
"I'm in my office now." Xiao Tian answered instantly. "Do you want to meet me?"

Even though Yun Xin Er knew nothing had happened to Xiao Tian, but she wanted to make sure he was fine by looking at his condition with her own eyes. That was why she called him when she had free time.
"Where are you right now? Are you busy?" because today Yun Xin Er had free time, she wanted to meet Xiao Tian.
Not only did she deny it, she even distorted the facts by saying that Xiao Tian wanted to meet her so badly.
Even though Yun Xin Er said that she would not let Xiao Tian kiss her lips but, in the end, Xiao Tian was able to kiss her lips.

And here when Lan Ruoxi wanted to get close to Xiao Tian, he always ignored her. Even though Xiao Tian always treated her nicely, but Lan Ruoxi knew that he always kept his distance to her as if he only wanted to have a business relationship with her.

When Yun Xin Er saw Xiao Tian, she immediately walked toward him. However, instead of saying something to him, Yun Xin Er walked around him while looking at him carefully as if she was looking for something on his body.
"Yes." Yun Xin Er nodded her head.
The corner of Xiao Tian's lips twitched when he saw what she was doing. He knew the reason she walked around him was that she wanted to know whether he was really fine or not.
After making sure that nothing had happened to Xiao Tian, Yun Xin Er hugged his right arm and pointed her index finger toward the wooden bench. "Let's sit over there."

Even though Rainbow Garden was a special place for both of them, but Xiao Tian also thought that it would better to meet at another place once a while. "So, why did you suddenly want to meet me? Did you miss me?"
Of course, Xiao Tian didn't mind it and let her do whatever she wanted. "Nothing happened to me, so you don't need to do this."
That was why Xiao Tian told his underlings to guard his company and shop so that when they made a move again, Xiao Tian would know.
"Little brother, I know you miss me so badly. That is why I give you a chance to meet me." even though Yun Xin Er missed Xiao Tian, but she would not say it.
Xiao Tian didn't expect Yun Xin Er would say something like that. However, Xiao Tian didn't try to deny it and decided to take advantage of the situation.
"Because we always met at Rainbow Garden, so I want to meet you at another place." Yun Xin Er gave him an honest answer.
"All right." because Xiao Tian had finished working on his important work, he agreed to meet Yun Xin Er immediately.
Sometimes, Lan Ruoxi even wondered whether she was not attractive enough in Xiao Tian's eyes. Many men wanted to get close to her, but they didn't have the chance to do that.

"Oh! Really?" even though Yun Xin Er said something like that, Xiao Tian was sure if he wanted to kiss her lips, she would not refuse because she had said something like that many times before but, in the end, she always let him kiss her.
But what made him sigh was that she didn't believe his words when he said that nothing had happened to him.
"Jinlan Lake?" after hearing her words, Xiao Tian suddenly remembered his aunt because a few days ago, she went to Jinlan Lake with her. "All right. What time do you want us to meet?"
